message.content: On April 25th, Li Hua expressed interest in inviting a friend to their jam session. In the conversation, Li Hua introduced their friend as Chae, who is described as a neurosurgeon. This indicates that Li Hua intends to bring Chae to their jam session. The nature of the friend's involvement suggests that Chae might bring a unique perspective and potentially a different musical background to the group, as indicated by the discussions about mixing up the music genre and the mention of classical rock songs.
